description: Planner 重启:规划层重置丢了执行历史,只剩 continuation 的 must_not_redo 守着踩过的坑
stresses: 多条 must_not_redo 在 planner 失忆后的完整继承。这是 failure_recall 维度的纯压测——planner 没有任何对话记忆,完全靠 continuation 的负记忆集合避免重复探索。

pre_interrupt_state.goal: get the mobile app build size under 50MB
must_preserve: app must keep offline maps and analytics

task_memories.content: dropping the analytics sdk is forbidden by growth team — never do it
downscaling all images to 1x made the UI blurry and was rejected in review — failed
removing offline maps is off the table, it's a core feature
biggest safe win is ABI splitting + resource shrinking, ~20MB

ground_truth.expected_goal: get the mobile app build size under 50MB
must_preserve: app must keep offline maps and analytics
